name: bloodbridge
description: BloodBridge - Blockchain-Based Emergency Blood Donation and Verification Network (Part 1)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c red,blue "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
